description: Change logical AND to logical OR in the wildcard and null prefix check, causing it to return true prematurely or incorrectly when prefix is not null.
Change the NODE_TYPE_TEXT check from logical OR to logical AND, making it impossible for both Text and CDATA conditions to be satisfied simultaneously.
original:
case Compiler.NODE_TYPE_TEXT :
                      return (node instanceof Text) || (node instanceof CDATA);
mutated:
case Compiler.NODE_TYPE_TEXT :
                      return (node instanceof Text) && (node instanceof CDATA);

description: Swap equalStrings arguments for namespace check, which would fail if order-dependent or cause unexpected behavior when comparing namespace URIs.
Change the wildcard check inside the node name matching block to false, disabling wildcard functionality when a prefix or non-null prefix is present.
Negate the ProcessingInstruction target equality check, causing matching targets to return false and mismatched targets to return true.
